steps.label: Grafana is cloud-agnostic

steps.label: Data source plugins
steps.sub: where the cloud-specific logic actually lives

code:
datasources:
  - name: Azure Monitor - Prod
    type: grafana-azure-monitor-datasource
    jsonData:
      azureAuthType: msi
      subscriptionId: "0000-0000"

  - name: CloudWatch - Prod
    type: cloudwatch
    jsonData:
      authType: default
      defaultRegion: us-east-1
caption: One YAML file in provisioning/datasources/ — both exist the moment Grafana starts.
Each panel's datasource field picks its plugin — the rendering engine never has to know which cloud.
